itemized.notes: 5-page handwritten filing (Joe Hatch, County Council, interim report 10/31/06). p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3-p4 Schedule A ('Page 3 of 5', 'Page 4 of 5'), p5 Schedule B ('Page 5 of 5'). All-capitals ballpoint hand. TWO conventions matter here: (1) the filer writes years as a SINGLE DIGIT ('9|15|6'), decoded as 2006 on the document's own evidence (the Date of Report box reads '10|31|6' on every schedule page for the October 31 2006 interim) - this is the filer's abbreviation, not a year inferred from the report date; (2) most amounts end in a trailing dash ('125-', '2,000-'), which per the currency convention means no cents, so they are recorded as X.00 with the verbatim glyph string in each row note. IN-KIND: a '*' marker with the printed legend '* IN KIND' at the foot of p3 and p5 marks three contributions (Donald Dunn 125, Frank A. Langheinrich 500, U.P.E.A. 500) and the three matching expenditures (Dunn/fund raiser, Langheinrich/photographs, UPEA/printing) - the same three items appear on both sides by the filer's design and both sides' totals require them. THE EXPENDITURE SIDE CARRIES A $6.00 INTERNAL FILER ERROR: the rows agree with the page subtotal to the cent, but the filer's own schedule TOTAL (and hence the Summary Page) is $6.00 higher. One vendor name is partly illegible (an overwritten word, p5 row 4) and is left as the glyph string at low confidence with needs_review=1. p4 row 1 carries two strike-throughs inside the name cell.
